name: Texture Drive
description: Sobel edge intensity controls drive. A detailed fabric or leaf produces a stronger signal than a plain wall; this responds to spatial detail even when the scene is still. A threshold and closing mask expose the largest connected edge region: its box and pink center mark show where X/Y are measured. The original drive signal still comes from the Sobel mean before masking.
steps: Point the camera at a plain surface, then move to a textured surface.
Map CC 23, channel 1 to distortion drive using your plugin MIDI Learn.
Sobel mean still controls drive. The final mask adds largest-region X/Y; drag either reading to an input to use it instead.
Adjust mask Lower bound to isolate edges. The green box and pink cross identify the largest connected region.
X/Y are normalized: left/top 0, right/bottom 1. No region returns 0; multiple regions can switch selection.
Use Calibration Capture for drive range. Drag largest-region X/Y from Measured outputs to a mixer input when needed.
